name: handdrawn-explainer
description: Hand-drawn whiteboard explainer videos from a scene file: wobbly strokes, handwriting, typeset LaTeX, a pen, TTS narration in five languages, MP4 + SRT for YouTube and Shorts. Ships as a Claude / Codex skill.

scripts.example: node scripts/narrate.mjs examples/fk-two-link/scene.json --engine mock && node scripts/build.mjs examples/fk-two-link/scene.json && echo 'open examples/fk-two-link/build/preview.html'
scripts.check: node --check runtime/board.js && node --check scripts/build.mjs && node --check scripts/narrate.mjs && node --check scripts/render.mjs
